data: Apple's net income fell from $99,803 million in fiscal 2022 (year ended September 24, 2022) to $93,736 million in fiscal 2024 (year ended September 28, 2024). That is a decrease of $6,067 million, or about 6.1%. Net income also dropped in between, to $96,995 million in fiscal 2023. The fiscal 2024 decline came despite higher operating income ($123,216 million versus $119,437 million in fiscal 2022). It was driven largely by a much higher provision for income taxes, which rose to $29,749 million in fiscal 2024 from $19,300 million in fiscal 2022.
